name: Dead Letter from the Mainframe
description: A vintage mainframe terminal has resurfaced on the lab network, surrounded by noisy legacy systems. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Recover the archived audit token from the service that holds it.

tasks.name: Recover the audit token
tasks.description: The mainframe's old terminal array is answering on the lab network among several decoys. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Recover the audit token held by the genuine service.
hints: Some listeners may look familiar from their ports, but compare how each one actually responds.
One listener speaks a standard mail-transfer protocol. Explore its supported dialogue and verification behavior.
Try verifying the archivist mailbox identity; the accepted mailbox response contains the record to recover.
